upload.description:
서른 번째 불합격 문자가 왔다.
'귀하의 역량은 훌륭하나'로 시작하는.

고시원 창문 너머 남의 집 불빛을 보며 라면 물이 끓는 동안 또 이력서를 씁니다.
전도서는 말합니다. 심을 때가 있고 거둘 때가 있다고.
나는 늦은 게 아니라, 아직 내 차례가 안 왔을 뿐입니다.

🎵 서른 번째 불합격 - MIDLIFE COMMUTER
💬 지금 '내 차례'를 기다리고 있는 누군가에게 한마디 남겨 주세요.

가사는 사람이 쓰고, 음악(ACE-Step)과 그림은 AI와 함께 만들었습니다.

scenes.plate: a narrow Korean gosiwon hallway at night seen at eye level, rows of identical small numbered doors on both sides, a long fluorescent ceiling light, a worn linoleum floor

scenes.plate: a tiny Korean gosiwon room at night, a narrow desk with a laptop and stacks of books, sticky notes on the wall, dim lamp light

scenes.motion: the young man reads the message on his phone with a disappointed face, the laptop screen light flickers on his face, nothing else moves

scenes.motion: steam rises from the boiling ramen pot on the counter, the laptop screen glows on the counter, the young man looks at the screen with tired eyes and stays still

scenes.plate: the flat rooftop of a small Seoul building before dawn seen at eye level, a low railing, laundry lines, the city skyline under a deep blue sky turning pink at the horizon

scenes.plate: a bare winter tree in a small Korean city park with many tiny new buds on its branches, soft golden morning sunlight, a clear pale blue sky
scenes.motion: the young man looks up at the tiny buds on the branches with a hopeful smile, the branches sway gently, sunlight sparkles

scenes.plate: the empty flat rooftop of a small Seoul building at sunrise seen at eye level, a low railing, the sun rising between the city buildings, golden light and a few clouds, nobody else on the rooftop
scenes.motion: the young man stands still facing the rising sun, golden light spreads across the city, clouds drift slowly, the rooftop stays empty
